pages.title: Cell Membrane
pages.text: A wall two molecules thick, oily inside and wet outside, that keeps a cell itself. Found on the surface of Inner Space's Tissue and the beds of its Bloodstream. The Patch-Clamp Rig peels Lipid Bilayers from it; matrix and a bilayer make more.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inner Space.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Bioluminescent Membrane, Lipid Bilayer.
